title: Minimum Queen Moves to Reach Target
summary: On an empty eight-by-eight chessboard, return the minimum queen moves between source and target. A move travels a positive distance along one row, column or diagonal while staying on the board. Equal endpoints require zero moves.
officialConstraints: Both coordinates are pairs with components 1..8.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
